title: Street quartet singing with Red Happy and Black Benny
summary: As kids Louis and others sang jive quartets in the street.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Did he sing when he was young?

No, at that time, you know, he jived around. Some of him and the boys around, they walked around for D.A. Liberty, little quartets. Him and Red Happy and Black Benny and a few more of them, you know. Just jive singing. Kids, you know, like they were doing the street jazz.
